beats.narrativePurpose: Hook attention and isolate the core operational bottleneck.
beats.viewerQuestion: What mistake is slowing down my system or workflow?
beats.spokenLine: If you are building with Claude, re-sending entire documents on every prompt wastes substantial bandwidth.
beats.visualBody: Re-sending large context files on every API call slows down your pipeline.

beats.narrativePurpose: Visually demonstrate data flow and memory lifecycle.
beats.viewerQuestion: How does data move through the actual system components?
beats.spokenLine: Prompt caching stores your system instructions in memory, allowing subsequent calls to read directly from cache.
beats.visualBody: Cached prompt prefixes bypass repetitive context ingestion on subsequent calls.

beats.narrativePurpose: Provide authentic, copy-pasteable syntax with zero pseudo-code.
beats.viewerQuestion: What exact configuration or command line syntax is needed?
beats.spokenLine: Simply add the ephemeral cache control block to your system prompt to activate instant prefix matching.

beats.narrativePurpose: Deliver verifiable conclusion citing authentic documentation.
beats.viewerQuestion: What is the concrete architectural takeaway?
beats.spokenLine: Structure your static context at the start of the prompt to maximize warm cache hits and minimize latency.
beats.visualBody: Place static instructions at the top and dynamic queries at the bottom to maximize cache hits.
